data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, **I'd start with Stripe or Shopify Payments**\. They offer a good balance of transaction fees, ease of use, reliability and room to grow.

The best option depends mainly on what platform your store uses, how much you sell and whether you take international payments.

## Best payment processors for a small UK online store

![Expert Pricing – Tutora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/s215eOkCrBJePJ6aedIAPORR2dSQKpg4r3kdjo_wlgJnHkyQ2l5DLHu9GE6cuq7DyIdsT5AkGFo_O1lteac7Hs-JP8Zcc66y70mgHCRBP4oIOblvA2wYsTXPnCEklYN9pAD0oC9n8Sn7qYbRw4Qg_jr4Bc3IEn5KMxhAijD_r0bRoq8DtkAmGOw6J64vSDi0?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

Best for independent online stores and flexibility.

- UK cards: approximately 1.5% + 20p.
- No standard monthly fee.
- Supports cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and subscriptions.
- Excellent integrations and developer tools.

Website: [Stripe UK](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

Best if your website is already built on Shopify.

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- No separate payment gateway setup.
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees that can apply when using external gateways.
- Convenient order and payment management.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal Checkout**

Best as an additional payment option.

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers.
- Customers can pay using PayPal or eligible cards.
- Standard domestic commercial rate generally 2.9% plus a fixed fee.
- Can help customers who prefer not to enter card details directly.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

Best for online and physical retail combined.

- Simple online checkout.
- Free entry-level online store.
- Integrates online and in-person sales.
- UK online card rate around 1.4% + 25p.

Website: [Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

These are indicative UK standard rates; card type, international payments and currency conversion can change the cost. [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/best-online-payment-solutions/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[startups.co.uk](https://startups.co.uk/payment-processing/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paypal.com](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business/paypal-business-fees?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[stripe.com](https://stripe.com/gb/payments?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For most new independent online stores\:

- **Use Stripe** if you have a standalone website, WooCommerce or a custom-built store.
- **Use Shopify Payments** if you're running Shopify.
- **Add PayPal** as an alternative checkout method to give customers more choice.

I wouldn't pay a monthly gateway subscription when starting out unless your sales volume justifies it.
